title: PersonaScienceBench: Evaluating Scientific Agents with Diverse Simulated Researchers
abstract: arXiv:2610.32106v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Scientific agents collaborate with researchers whose expertise and preferences differ, but benchmarks usually hold the collaborator fixed. We introduce PersonaScienceBench: 200 tasks from five benchmarks across four scientific domains. Simulated researchers provide context and feedback according to persona profiles, while task objectives and grading remain fixed. Agents encounter researcher preferences only through conversation. Across eighteen modelconfigurations, task performance, fact recovery, and self-repetition reveal different strengths. Detailed GPT 6 Astra analyses show distinct agent responses across researcher profiles; interaction traces illustrate targeted clar ification and workflow revision. These behaviors can differ even when final scores match. PersonaScienceBench therefore evaluates how agents collaborate with diverse researchers alongside whether they complete the task.

translated_title: PersonaScienceBench：利用多样化模拟研究人员评估科学智能体
translated_abstract: 科学智能体需要与专业知识和偏好各不相同的研究人员协作，但现有基准测试通常将协作者固定不变。我们提出了PersonaScienceBench：包含来自四个科学领域五个基准的200个任务。模拟研究人员根据角色档案提供上下文和反馈，而任务目标和评分标准保持固定。智能体只能通过对话来了解研究人员的偏好。在十八种模型配置的测试中，任务表现、事实恢复和自我重复揭示了不同的优势。对GPT 6 Astra的详细分析显示，智能体对不同研究人员档案的反应各不相同；交互轨迹展示了有针对性的澄清和工作流程修订。即使最终得分相同，这些行为也可能存在差异。因此，PersonaScienceBench在评估智能体能否完成任务的同时，还能评估它们与多样化研究人员协作的方式。
tldr: PersonaScienceBench通过引入具有不同角色档案的模拟研究人员，在任务目标和评分标准保持固定的前提下，评估科学智能体与多样化研究人员协作的能力，而不仅仅评估其完成任务的表现。
en_tdlr: PersonaScienceBench evaluates how scientific agents collaborate with diverse simulated researchers—whose preferences are conveyed only through persona-driven conversation—alongside whether they complete tasks, revealing distinct agent behaviors even when final scores match.
